The revoked designations stay revoked as a surviving consequence (owner ruling 2026-10-28). The held page text also prints text of a neighboring order before this order's heading (character offsets before 2267, including a clause about Title I of the First War Powers Act); that text belongs to another order and was not used. AI producer hypothesis only; not human certification.
savings_reason: The order contains no savings, transfer or exemption language. Its only lasting effect, that the designations of Cordova and Mahukona as customs ports of entry stand revoked, is an accrued consequence of the performed revocation; nothing continues as a command after 1942-12-05.

Clauses are quoted from that registered file, not from the clause-drafts copy. The order further exempts George T. Summerlin, a Foreign Service Officer of Class I, from compulsory retirement for age under section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932 (47 Stat. 382, 404) for such time as may be deemed necessary, but not beyond the close of business November 30, 1947. Under the Emergency Relief Appropriation Act of 1935 and the act of February 11, 1936 the President appoints Benjamin W. Thoron, Director, Division of Territories and Island Possessions, Department of the Interior, as Administrator of the Puerto Rico Reconstruction Administration, vice Guy J. Swope, resigned, to serve without additional compensation and to exercise the functions conferred on the Administration and Administrator by Executive Orders 7057, 7180 (as amended by 7554) and 7689, and amends those orders accordingly. The order is a one-time appointment and amendment, complete when issued on 1942-12-04; Thoron's later service is a historical consequence of the appointment, and the functions he exercised are conferred by the earlier orders, which keep their own lifecycles. A later order, EO 9618 (September 19, 1945), appoints a successor 'vice Benjamin W. Thoron, resigned', showing the service had ended by resignation on a date before then that no held source gives; that is recorded as a later event, not an end. Applying the owner ruling of 2026-10-28, the appointing act is recorded as exhausted by performance and the surviving appointment is separated from it. AI producer hypothesis only; not human certification.
